chunks: Al-Ḥalabī asked him about catching fish, even if the name of Allah was not mentioned.
So he said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.الْحَلَبِيُّ: Al-Ḥalabī, the narrator asking the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible
key_terms.يُسَمَّ: the name of Allah being mentioned

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to catch fish without mentioning the name of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that catching fish is permissible even if the name of Allah is not mentioned over it. It addresses a jurisprudential question related to hunting and lawful consumption.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4160 - Al-Halabi asked him about catching fish without mentioning the name of Allah (swt) over it.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
